summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights near University of Teesside, Middlesbrough, with a 1.61 nautical mile radius and drones limited to 400 feet above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD494E INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
543419N 0011405W (UNIVERSITY OF TEESSIDE, MIDDLESBROUGH). BEYOND
VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA.
MAX HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN
ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC
CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA
WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, 
FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE 
OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER 
CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE 
EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-5530/04.
